findings.title: Copied finish() has an unbound time global
findings.evidence: The exact first-delay expression from line111 was compiled and evaluated with its required task/total/seconds_per_frame locals and the new module's absent time binding; it raised NameError: name 'time' is not defined. The original imports time at complete_candidate_benchmarks.py:8, but the new import list does not. Importing wait_owned from the original module does not bind time in resume_candidate_benchmarks.py.
findings.consequence: After the existing C task completes, main launches the first two dev tracking jobs at lines121-123, then line125 enters finish() and fails at111 before waiting, collection, scoring, freeze or the full three benchmarks. A scheduler cannot repair this Python name resolution error.
findings.required_change: Add the missing import to the new controller, preserve this failed review/input snapshot, then bind and review the resulting new source and plan. No NN training rerun is needed.

findings.title: Nested checker inherited PowerShell7 module search roots
findings.evidence: powershell_01 joined exit1 because Get-FileHash did not resolve under Python-subprocess-inherited PSModulePath, which puts PowerShell7 roots ahead of WindowsPowerShell roots. powershell_02 changed checker-only I/O/hash/serialization to .NET and completed AST checks, without executing the scripts. The separate executor receipt e65324 joined exit0 in the normal WindowsPowerShell environment and resolved Get-FileHash, ConvertFrom-Json and Get-ScheduledTask from Utility/ScheduledTasks.
findings.consequence: This is not evidence that registration or scheduling succeeded. Use the verified normal WindowsPowerShell invocation environment; actual registration/task XML/worker receipts remain pending. No production compatibility layer or global environment change was made.
